old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a hydraulic press actively compressing a stack of wooden planks bound with clear plastic wrap. The press is mounted on a black and yellow striped base, which serves as a safety warning to indicate the hazardous nature of the equipment. The metal cylinder of the press is applying force, causing gradual deformation and compression of the wooden planks. The background remains static, focusing entirely on the mechanical setup without any additional elements or distractions. The video provides a detailed look at the hydraulic press and the wooden materials as they are being compressed.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a hydraulic press in action, compressing a stack of wooden planks. The press is mounted on a black and yellow striped base, which serves as a safety warning to indicate the hazardous nature of the equipment. The wooden planks are tightly bound together with a clear plastic wrap, ensuring they remain intact during the compression process. As the hydraulic press descends, it exerts increasing pressure on the wooden stack. The wood begins to compress visibly, showing signs of deformation under the force. The metal cylinder of the press moves steadily downward, applying consistent pressure throughout the sequence. The background remains static, focusing entirely on the mechanical process without any additional elements or distractions. The video provides a detailed look at the mechanics of the hydraulic press and the physical transformation of the wooden materials under extreme pressure.
caption: The video captures a close-up, stationary view of a compression-testing rig in operation. A large polished cylindrical steel platen presses downward onto a horizontal stack of pale wooden sticks bound together in clear plastic film. The stack rests on a cylindrical base painted with diagonal yellow-and-black hazard stripes, set against a flat pale grey-green machine frame, with a matching striped guide rail fixed at the left edge. Throughout the excerpt the base, frame, and left rail hold their positions, confirming the camera does not move. The steel platen descends steadily relative to the static base, its lower edge sinking toward the uppermost stick. Under this pressure the wrapped stack shortens visibly, its overall height shrinking as the platen continues its slow downward travel. A splintered stick end protrudes more prominently at the upper-right side of the stack as the compression proceeds. The clear plastic wrap creases and shifts slightly around the binding but stays in place.
